parameters.help_en: The callable time period for the task, formatted as a JSON object that contains two properties: beginTime and EndTime
parameters.help_zh: 任务的可外呼时段，格式为JSON对象，对象包含两个属性，beginTime和EndTime
parameters.name: callable_time

parameters.help_en: The task contact list. This is the key of an OSS object, which can be obtained by calling the GenerateFileUploadParams operation. You can also leave this parameter empty and add contacts later by calling the AppendCases operation
parameters.help_zh: 任务名单，是一个OSS对象的Key，通过GenerateFileUploadParams接口获取。也可以不设置，后续通过AppendCases接口追加联系人
parameters.name: case_file_key

fields.help_en: The custom variables defined by the customer, formatted as a JSON object. The object can contain up to 10 properties, and the name and value of each property are defined by the customer
fields.help_zh: 客户自定义变量，格式为JSON对象，对象最多包含10个属性，每个属性的名称和值均由客户自定义
fields.name: custom_variables

fields.help_en: The phone number of the contact
fields.name: phone_number

fields.help_en: The priority of the contact. Default value: 1
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en: The business ID of the contact
fields.name: reference_id

parameters.help_en: The contact list. You can also leave this parameter empty and add contacts later by calling the AppendCases operation
parameters.help_zh: 联系人列表。也可以不设置，后续通过 AppendCases 接口追加联系人
parameters.name: cases

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of attempts, which specifies the maximum number of times to call a number when a call fails
parameters.help_zh: 最大尝试次数，表示当号码呼叫失败时，最多呼几次
parameters.name: max_attempt_count

parameters.help_en: The list of calling numbers for the outbound task
parameters.help_zh: 外呼任务的主叫号码列表
parameters.name: numbers

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to maintain the scheduling state until the campaign end time after all contacts are called. Default value: false. Valid values:
true: The task remains in the scheduling state, and you can continue to add contacts.
false: The task changes to the completed state, and you cannot add contacts
parameters.name: run_until_end_time

parameters.help_en: The outbound call timeout in seconds. Default value: 25
parameters.name: dialing_timeout_seconds

parameters.help_en:
The minimum concurrency. This is the minimum concurrency set for the task. A value of 0 indicates that no baseline is set, and resources are allocated based on weights.

If multiple campaigns have the minimum concurrency set:

If the total concurrency is less than the total concurrency of the instance, the minimum concurrency of each task is prioritized, and the excess resources are allocated proportionally based on weights.

If the total concurrency is greater than the total concurrency of the instance, the minimum concurrency no longer serves as a baseline, but participates in the calculation as a weight factor
parameters.help_zh:
最小并发数。任务设置的最小并发数，0表示不设保底，按权重分配。

若多个活动都设置了最小并发

如果总并发小于实例总并发，优先满足每个任务的“最小并发”，多出的资源按权重比例额外分配。

如果总并发大于实例总并发，“最小并发”不再作为保底值，而是作为权重因子参与计算
parameters.name: fixed_quota

parameters.help_en:
The list of restrictions for outbound call attempts. If this parameter is not specified, no restrictions are applied. Valid values:
CALLEE_NOT_EXISTS: Do not call nonexistent numbers.
OUT_OF_SERVICE: Do not call suspended numbers
parameters.help_zh:
外呼尝试限制条件列表,不传表示不限制。
CALLEE_NOT_EXISTS 空号不外呼
OUT_OF_SERVICE 停机不外呼
parameters.name: redial_restrictions

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to prohibit outbound calls on holidays
parameters.name: holiday_restricted

parameters.help_en:
The call execution order. Default value: MIN_ATTEMPT_FIRST. Valid values:
PRIORITY_FIRST: Prioritize by priority.
MIN_ATTEMPT_FIRST: Prioritize by the number of attempts
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫执行顺序，默认MIN_ATTEMPT_FIRST
PRIORITY_FIRST， 按优先级优先
MIN_ATTEMPT_FIRST，按尝试次数优先
parameters.name: attempt_order

parameters.help_en: The weight, which is an integer ranging from 0 to 100. A larger value indicates that more concurrency is allocated during scheduling
parameters.help_zh: 权重，为范围0～100的整数。值越大，调度时分配的并发越多
parameters.name: weight

Data.description_en: The returned data, which is the task ID

Message.description_en: The message returned by the API

Params.description_en: The variable values in the error message

items.description_en: The variable values in the error message

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
